{{short description|Belgian mathematical statistician}}
'''Mia Hubert''' is a Belgian [[mathematical statistics|mathematical statistician]] known for her research on topics in [[robust statistics]] including [[medoid]]-based clustering,{{ran|a}} [[regression depth]],{{ran|b}} the [[medcouple]] for robustly measuring [[skewness]],{{ran|c}} [[box plot]]s for skewed data,{{ran|f}} and robust [[principal component analysis]],{{ran|d}} and for her implementations of robust statistical algorithms in the [[R (programming language)|R statistical software system]], [[MATLAB]],{{ran|e}} and [[S-PLUS]].{{ran|a}} She is a professor in the statistics and data science section of the department of mathematics at [[KU Leuven]].{{r|kul}}

==Education and career==
Hubert earned a diploma in mathematics in 1992 from the [[University of Antwerp]],{{r|cv}} and obtained her [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in 1997 at the same university. Her dissertation, ''Robust Regression for Data Analysis'', was supervised by [[Peter Rousseeuw]].{{r|mg}} She joined the KU Leuven faculty in 2001.{{r|cv}}

She was the original developer of the [[R package]] ''cluster'' along with Peter Rousseeuw and Anja Struyf.{{r|cluster}}

==Recognition==
Hubert became an Elected Member of the [[International Statistical Institute]] in 2013.{{r|cv|isimem}}
